svg.title: One click on the reference RTX 4070: 1.6 % more speed on 8 % less power, with the fans at 62 % instead of 73 %
svg.desc: One All in one run, five minutes of full load at stock against five minutes after it. Stress-test score 5728 to 5820 iterations per second, power 196 to 180 watts, fan speed 73 to 62 percent. A second run gave 0.9 percent more score on 10.8 percent less power with the fans at 55 percent. The profiles that go for one thing only: Best of my GPU, 4.5 percent more speed; Undervolt, 20 percent less power and 8 degrees cooler.
svg.text: ONE CLICK, MEASURED ON THE REFERENCE CARD

g.text: 196 W to 180 W under full load

svg.text: All in one, the default: overclock, undervolt and fan curve in one 34-minute run, tested as a whole.
Want all of one thing? Best of my GPU: +4.5 % speed. Undervolt: −20 % power, 8 °C cooler.
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 · five minutes at stock against five minutes after · a second run: +0.9 %, −10.8 %, 55 %
